about: Local operator benchmark (D-068). Every task is checked from outside the agent. Files go to the owner's Downloads folder and are deleted afterwards.

tasks.task: Open Notepad and type: Relay bench one
Open Notepad, type 'Relay bench two', and save it as relay-bench-2.txt in the Downloads folder.
Open Notepad, type 'cat dog cat', then use Replace to change every cat to bird.
Open Calculator and work out 12 times 34.
Open Calculator and work out the square root of 144.
Open the web browser and go to example.com.
In the web browser, open en.wikipedia.org and search for Alan Turing.
Open File Explorer and show the Downloads folder.
Open Windows Settings and go to the Display page.
